paragraphs: SPECTRUM SUPPORT PHONE NUMBER: 877-647-7732 is the Community Solutions Line for Bulk Owners Customer Support. This phone number is setup for Communities like Palm Hill. Call first for any issue like internet, TV, billing...etc. When you speak to someone at Spectrum, identify yourself as part of a Bulk Owner Community, Palm Hill in Largo.
MORE INFO: PALM HILL WEBSITE OFFERS SPECTRUM INFO PAGE

Log on to palmhillcountryclub.net, navigate to the Members section, click Spectrum/XUMO from the menu for info on Spectrum’s streaming offerings, training, listings and in-depth info about the Spectrum transition. (You can also use the search box on the Home Page and type “Spectrum” to find the page.)

Did you know with our new Spectrum set up we have access to several music channels? Simply turn on your TV then select the Spectrum app. Press the right navigation button on your remote to open the TV guide. Type in the number "400" and wait. That will take you to the start of 50 music channels from classical, easy listening, blues, jazz, 60s, 70s, 80s, country and many more. Enjoy!
